description: Different model profiles should preserve the bounded single-package Cargo command, direct Rust test evidence, and candidate actions.

lockedFields.reason: A conventional single-package Cargo project with built-in tests should retain its native verification command.
The untested checkout service should remain the one add-test item.
The parser integration test and inline validator test should remain bounded extend-test items.
The directly asserted parser should retain a stable plan item.
The integration test should retain exact crate-module import provenance.
The imported parser call remains consumed by a built-in assertion macro.
The untested branching service should retain its stable add-test item.
The inline cfg(test) module should remain attached to its owning source file.

unexpectedVariations: integration imports credited across the wrong crate or module
inline tests detached from their source owner
